system.description:
You etch a rune of your choosing onto a weapon or piece of ammunition: Flame, Frost, Shock, or Force. While the rune lasts, the weapon deals extra damage of the chosen type on a hit.

Scaling: At dice count 3, the bonus damage increases. At dice count 6, you can inscribe runes on up to 2 weapons at once. At dice count 9, the rune also grants the wielder resistance to its own damage type. At dice count 12, the duration increases to 8 hours. At dice count 15, the rune becomes permanent, bonded to the weapon.
